description: This file defines a custom watch face service for Wear OS that displays time and user's daily step count synchronized via Google Fit API. The class manages drawing the watch face, updating time, connecting to Google Fit to retrieve step data, and handling ambient and interactive modes.

classes.name: FitStepsWatchFaceService
classes.description: Main service class extending CanvasWatchFaceService, providing watch face engine.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Inner class extending CanvasWatchFaceService.Engine, managing drawing, Google Fit API connection, and time updates.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes paint objects, GoogleApiClient, registers broadcast receivers, and sets watch face style.

methods.name: onVisibilityChanged
methods.description: Handles connection to Google Fit API and event registration when visibility changes.

methods.name: onApplyWindowInsets
methods.description: Adjusts layout based on whether the watch face is round or square, sets text sizes.

methods.name: onPropertiesChanged
methods.description: Adjusts anti-aliasing and other properties based on device capabilities.

methods.name: onTimeTick
methods.description: Updates step count and redraws the watch face periodically.

methods.name: onAmbientModeChanged
methods.description: Handles transitions to and from ambient mode, adjusting rendering quality.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the current time and step count onto the canvas.
